items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Baptiste was there. What is Baptiste a gambler? Trumpet there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, anyhow, that's where we stopped that. But he know he had, he know he had friends there, see.

Yeah. I walked over there. And, uh, Baptiste was there. What is Baptiste a gambler? Trumpet there. He told, uh, Bad, he said, what you gonna do today? I said, well, Bad, you should take lessons. Yeah. Well, he said, well, Bad, you should take lessons. You know what I mean? Father, he's a great father of Buddy Petit. Uh-huh. I'm going to borrow your horn. You're dead. Bad asked me, say, where you gonna sleep at? Well, Bad had a rooming house down the street. Bad said, I ain't got nowhere to play. I ain't going…
